name: Quadtree Blocks
description: The first clip breaks into a quadtree of flat color blocks, small where it is detailed and large where it is plain; the blocks merge into a few big squares that change color one by one, then split again, finer and finer, into the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: tolerance
params.description: How different the colors inside a block may be before it splits (larger gives bigger blocks)

params.name: seams
params.description: Darkness of the thin seams between the blocks
